title: OAuthClient
description: OAuthClient represents a registered OAuth client in Posit Connect.

id.description: The internal numeric identifier of this OAuth client.

client_id.description: The OAuth client_id string used during authorization flows.

client_name.description: An optional human-readable name for this OAuth client.

redirect_uris.description: The redirect URIs registered for this OAuth client.

created_at.description: The timestamp (RFC3339) when this OAuth client was registered.

last_used_at.description: The timestamp (RFC3339) when this OAuth client was last used, or null if never used.
